name: Required partner presence and coexpression
description: Score evidence that the partner molecules required by the candidate function are present in the relevant genome and expressed together under the relevant experimental conditions.

native_measurements.name: Native E-value for an identified required-partner match
method_requirements: Keep partner identity, query/reference lengths, program/version, database/search size and exact original request.
The required-partner list must come from the proposed function and cited system definition.
comparison_limits: An E-value is evidence of a match, not direct proof of assembly or function.
Scores from different programs/search spaces are not automatically comparable.

native_measurements.name: Native bit score for an identified required-partner match
method_requirements: Identify which required partner, matching subject and run produced the score.
comparison_limits: Do not count multiple representations of the same match as independent partner evidence.

native_measurements.name: Matched fraction of the actual partner query
method_requirements: Preserve matched intervals and full query length; partial assemblies stay identified.
comparison_limits: Full coverage does not establish exact molecular function.

native_measurements.name: Actual condition-matched coexpression or association statistic
units: native statistic unit retained from its method
method_requirements: Name the statistic, samples, conditions, normalization, replicate structure and exact analysis.
Use one matched experiment; artificial rescue coexpression is not native coexpression.
comparison_limits: No coexpression extractor is currently bound here; unavailable values stay unknown.
Adjacency, unmatched expression samples and correlation alone do not establish physical assembly.

native_measurements.name: Actual reported p/q value for the declared coexpression test
units: native p-value or q-value, identified explicitly
method_requirements: Retain the actual null/contrast and whether correction was performed; do not substitute p for q.
comparison_limits: No p-value is inferred from a correlation coefficient or sample count.

native_measurements.name: Number of partners explicitly required by this candidate system
method_requirements: Preserve the actual source experiment, fixed candidate/required set, matched sample/conditions, counting rule and original retained numeric result.
comparison_limits: This derived quantity requires actual retained analysis or published numeric data; unavailable extraction stays unknown and no count is inferred from missing annotation.

native_measurements.name: Number of required partners actually identified in the examined genome
method_requirements: Preserve the actual source experiment, fixed candidate/required set, matched sample/conditions, counting rule and original retained numeric result.
comparison_limits: This derived quantity requires actual retained analysis or published numeric data; unavailable extraction stays unknown and no count is inferred from missing annotation.

native_measurements.name: Number of required partners meeting the original matched-expression analysis criterion
method_requirements: Preserve the actual source experiment, fixed candidate/required set, matched sample/conditions, counting rule and original retained numeric result.
comparison_limits: This derived quantity requires actual retained analysis or published numeric data; unavailable extraction stays unknown and no count is inferred from missing annotation.

native_measurements.name: Number of required partners contradicted by competent, scope-qualified absence evidence
method_requirements: Preserve the actual source experiment, fixed candidate/required set, matched sample/conditions, counting rule and original retained numeric result.
comparison_limits: This derived quantity requires actual retained analysis or published numeric data; unavailable extraction stays unknown and no count is inferred from missing annotation.

judgment_criteria.question: Which partners does this proposed function actually require?

outcomes.met: A source-grounded system definition identifies each required partner and distinguishes optional components.
outcomes.not_met: The proposed requirement is contradicted by an experimentally demonstrated partner-independent system.
outcomes.unknown: The complex/process or required versus optional components have not been established.

judgment_criteria.question: Are the required partners identified in the relevant genome?

outcomes.met: Each reported identification resolves to its actual genome region and native homology evidence under stated detection criteria.
outcomes.not_met: A competent search of the relevant examined genome contradicts a claimed partner identification; report its scope and detection limits.
outcomes.unknown: A partner is unexamined, ambiguously matched, outside an incomplete assembly, or simply lacks annotation; do not equate these with absence.

judgment_criteria.question: Were the target and the required partners measured together under relevant conditions?

outcomes.met: The same matched experimental samples contain the target/partner measurements and the original native association statistic or explicit reported result.
outcomes.not_met: Actual matched observations contradict the proposed coexpression in the specified conditions.
outcomes.unknown: Expression data are missing, come from unmatched samples, or concern artificial rescue rather than native conditions.

judgment_criteria.question: Does partner evidence concern this target system or a justified homologous system?

outcomes.met: The original system is the target system or a separately established correspondence preserves the relevant component requirements.
outcomes.not_met: The observed system has a demonstrated incompatible component relationship.
outcomes.unknown: The connection between source system and target system is not established.

judgment_criteria.question: Do numerator and denominator describe the same fixed required-partner set and examined genome?

outcomes.met: Both counts use the exact same candidate-defined required set and genome; the denominator is positive and each partner occurs once.
outcomes.not_met: The counts use different required sets/genomes, duplicate partners or a nonpositive denominator.
outcomes.unknown: The required set, genome or counting rule cannot be established.

judgment_criteria.question: Does the coexpression count use that required set and one matched experiment?

outcomes.met: The numerator and denominator use the same required set, matched samples/conditions and the actual analysis’s stated association criterion.
outcomes.not_met: The count is from a different set, unmatched samples or an invented threshold.
outcomes.unknown: A required sample, criterion or counting rule is missing.

judgment_criteria.question: Does the actual measured contrast establish the proposed positive coexpression?

outcomes.met: The original relevant analysis reports the expected positive association using its declared effect/statistical criterion.
outcomes.not_met: A competent relevant test demonstrates the opposite association or a source-grounded incompatible pattern.
outcomes.unknown: Only adjacency, unmatched data, an unqualified nonsignificant result, or no relevant contrast is available.

judgment_criteria.question: Is an absent required partner actually supported by competent examined-genome evidence?

outcomes.met: An explicitly required partner is absent in an examined, appropriately covered genome under the stated detection model and limits.
outcomes.not_met: The proposed absence is contradicted by an identified partner.
outcomes.unknown: The genome/search is incomplete, detection limits are unknown, or only an annotation is missing.

transfer_chain.source_subject: Identify the organism, assayed or analysed protein, preparation and experiment that actually supplied each observation.
transfer_chain.source_property: Required-partner identities, actual genomic presence and condition-matched expression are separate measured properties.
transfer_chain.correspondence: For a different source protein or organism retain the actual sequence/structural correspondence and matched region; do not turn that source experiment into a target measurement.
transfer_chain.target_hypothesis: Identify the particular candidate annotation and the property being evaluated, including its biological conditions.
transfer_chain.limitations: Presence is not assembly; coexpression is not physical binding. Missing expression remains unknown. Preserve the same underlying experiment when a paper and dataset report it.

routes.interpretation: Native match score for an actually identified required partner; keep program, search space and partner identity. Zero remains a native zero, not an invented infinity.
Native required-partner match bit score; only like-method/search comparisons are declared comparable.

routes.score_unit: fraction of the fixed required-partner set
routes.interpretation: Identified required partners divided by the positive required-partner count. Missing partners are not declared absent by this ratio; preserve examined and unknown states.

routes.score_unit: fraction of the fixed required-partner set
routes.interpretation: Partners satisfying the original matched-expression analysis criterion divided by the same required set. No new correlation/p threshold is supplied by this rubric.
Original association effect, not probability of function. It must remain paired with the actual analysis/sample definition.

routes.score_unit: negative log10 of the explicitly identified native p/q value
routes.interpretation: Numeric strength of the actual positive-association test only. This is not a function probability, and nonsignificance alone is not opposition.

routes.score_unit: fraction of the fixed required-partner set
routes.interpretation: Explicitly supported absence of required partners divided by the positive required set; qualify detection limits.
